name: QED / PES road electronic
use_case: Road 2× semi-wireless electronic shifting in OEM core or full groupsets
positioning: QED is the lighter carbon-injection system and PES trades 100 g for lower-cost construction, but supplied 2026 service-action reports lack a matching official bulletin, so treat both as research-stage purchases.
architecture: Semi-wireless: levers communicate wirelessly; front and rear derailleurs connect to one internal seatpost battery.

weight.note: Official catalog: QED disc-brake core groupset 1,150 g; PES disc-brake core groupset 1,250 g. Core means levers, derailleurs and brakes, not cassette, chain or crank.

battery: 7.4 V 800 mAh seatpost battery, claimed 2,500 km derailleur range, 3-hour charge and 18-month shifter-battery life.
controls_and_app: App setup, synchronized shifting, three configurable X/Y/Z buttons, multi-scenario setup and bike-computer/light integration are listed.
package_summary: Core rim-brake kit covers levers and derailleurs; core disc kit adds brakes. Full and super OEM groupsets may add cassette, chain, crank or power-meter crank, and some packages add wheels.

compatibility.freehub: Depends on the chosen 10-13-speed cassette and exact QED/PES generation
compatibility.frame: Internal seatpost battery fit and power-wire routing
compatibility.brake_fluid: Confirm the exact caliper generation and specified fluid

china_price_status: No attributable mainland consumer price was captured; the bounded Taobao route timed out on 2026-08-24, while QED/PES availability remains primarily OEM/catalog and complete-bike based.
caveats: Public 2026 service-action and free-upgrade reports were supplied without a matching official bulletin; confirm the revised generation and written warranty before purchase.
Magene's direct platform lists a one-year warranty for the original purchaser; purchases through other official channels follow that channel's policy.
